headline: DNB, Norway's largest bank, will lay off about 400 employees in its technology and services unit as it uses more AI agents.
score_reason: Company statement reported by Reuters; limited to one unit.
importance_line: About 400 bank staff lose their jobs and AI agents (software that carries out tasks on its own) take over some manual work, according to the bank, though the effect on customers is not described.
summary: Reuters reports, as relayed by The Economic Times, that DNB said it has adopted AI agents to replace tasks once done by hand in some operations, and that CEO Kjerstin Braathen called it 'a new reality'. The bank expects to finish the cuts in the last three months of 2026, with the costs booked in the second quarter of 2027, and its shares rose about 1% after the announcement.
notes: Reuters page blocked; read the Reuters text carried by The Economic Times (a summary form).
